changeJustifications.summary: Rewrites TrustStorageRead::compute_module_stats so fan_in/fan_out are computed over the same derived module-dependency edge set modules list/deps render — resolved (static) file→file IMPORTS aggregated through module_file_ownership to the owning module candidate on both endpoints, intra-module pairs excluded (fan_out = COUNT DISTINCT target candidate, fan_in = COUNT DISTINCT source candidate) — dropping the nodes kind='MODULE' join that keyed on the file-less crate-root node (RC-5). Stable-key synthesis and file_count-from-ownership are unchanged; its two named unit tests are rewritten to the file-node/ownership fixture.

Rewrites the count_suspicious_modules_matches_all_criteria unit test (test-module only) to the true re-sourced behaviour, adding outbound-only and inbound-only fixtures that prove a module carrying any rendered edge in either direction is never flagged zero-connectivity; only a module with no incoming and no outgoing cross-module import (≥2 files, not the repo root) is suspicious.

Replaces the CONTRADICTION-SWEEP-1 'directory node / fan_in = fan_out = 0 / cross-check stats' basis sentence in render_suspicious_modules — which narrated internal pipeline machinery — with a reader-frame sentence ('no resolved import connects this module to another module in this snapshot … open the module to confirm'), now literally true because the fans read the same edge set modules deps renders.

Rewrites the suspicious-modules render test to assert the reader-frame basis is present and the internal-diagnostic wording (fan_in=fan_out=0, directory node, stats pointer) is absent, and renames it from suspicious_modules_state_basis_and_point_at_stats to suspicious_modules_basis_in_reader_frame_no_internal_wording (D-TME-TEST-NAME-1) so the identity matches the rewritten body; the retained-name comment is deleted.

New write-first cross-surface seam integration test (trust_module_fans_equal_modules_deps) that makes trust↔modules disagreement unrepresentable: it asserts trust --json modules[].fan_in/fan_out equal modules deps per-module fan counts for every rendered module on the two-crate and twin-names fixtures, so a module with rendered edges can never be listed zero-connectivity.

limitations: Honest movement, pre-authorised by D-TME-MOVEMENT-1: the alias_resolution_suspicion downgrade does NOT disappear — it persists wherever ≥3 genuinely zero-connectivity module candidates remain (repo-graph 6, kafka 5, FRAKTAG 3) and clears only where fewer remain (hadoop 2, vcmi 2). The ≥3 threshold in detect_alias_resolution_suspicion cannot distinguish unresolved imports from genuine isolation; recalibrating it is the separate follow-up ALIAS-SUSPICION-1 (out of scope for this slice).

Verdict LEVEL is unchanged on all five proof repos (Import-graph/Change-impact stay LOW while unresolved imports > 0); only the fan counts, the suspicious-module set, and the reader-frame basis sentence moved.

Outward proofs were run against isolated COPIES of the retained audit-v0.18.0 stores (the method the checks prescribe), with a base-revision git-worktree before-binary; no operator state was touched (C17).
